name: AdaBoost Look Up Table (LUT) Classification
definition: A classification method for volume data that uses a Look Up Table (LUT) to store trained AdaBoost weak classifiers (decision stumps) for rapid testing. It maps voxel features to class labels using an ECOC framework to handle multi-class problems via binary dichotomizers.
summary: AdaBoost LUT Classification accelerates volume rendering by storing trained weak classifiers in a compact 3-row lookup table for fast GPU testing, differing from standard methods by using ECOC-based binary dichotomizers.
